summary: No page of the operator's own found: the City of Plentywood has no findable website or campground page, so nothing was confirmed or changed. Derived values (30-amp electric, 18 sites, vault toilets, year-round, FCFS) left as they are.
flags: No official page: the entry has no website and no City of Plentywood page for the campground could be found (plentywood.org is a history page, not the city). As a town park it is exempt from removal on presence; every detail in the note and fields rests on aggregator listings and reviews. The phone 406-765-1700 (Campendium/AllStays) could not be confirmed from an official source.
Aggregator descriptions disagree on size (18 sites vs a 2018 review's 10 power/water sites plus 3 dry) and a 2024 review says payment was cash at the self-pay station or city hall.
